questions.stem: Where can Advance Analytics as a Service (AAaaS) be hosted?
options: Either on-premises or in the Cloud
questions.explanation: AAaaS has nothing to do with Cloud specifically; it can be on-premises or on Cloud.

questions.stem: For whom is an AAaaS environment set up?
options: Data Scientists working with Machine Learning and Deep Learning modelling
questions.explanation: AAaaS is an environment set up for Data Scientists to play around with Machine Learning and Deep Learning modelling.

questions.stem: Why is AAaaS described as still very confusing?
options: Because it has been banned in some countries
Because it only works with one vendor
Because it is a new, still-maturing concept and different companies offer different approaches
questions.explanation: AAaaS is a new and still-maturing concept, with different companies offering different approaches and no single best one.

questions.stem: How many approaches to AAaaS are described?
questions.explanation: Two approaches are followed: AAaaS as PaaS and AAaaS as SaaS.

questions.stem: Which tools are given as examples of AAaaS as PaaS?
questions.explanation: In the PaaS approach, modelling tools like Databricks and Azure AML are available as pre-installed services customers can provision in a few clicks.

questions.stem: In the AAaaS as PaaS approach, who is responsible for MLOps and CI/CD?
options: The customer, who must have their own MLOps along with CI/CD
Nobody, since MLOps is not needed
questions.explanation: With AAaaS as PaaS, customers build their own models and must have their own MLOps along with CI/CD.

questions.stem: What does a Solution Provider host in the AAaaS as SaaS approach?
options: Pre-built or OOTB Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for customers to consume
Empty modelling tools for customers to build models
questions.explanation: In the SaaS approach, providers host pre-built or OOTB ML and DL models that customers consume by injecting their own datasets.

questions.stem: In AAaaS as SaaS, whose MLOps and CI/CD must the customer follow?
questions.explanation: With AAaaS as SaaS, customers must follow the Solution Provider's MLOps along with CI/CD.

questions.stem: What do customers contribute in the AAaaS as SaaS approach?
options: Their own dataset for relevant analysis and analytics
questions.explanation: Customers inject their own dataset into the provider's pre-built models for the relevant data analysis and analytics.

questions.stem: Which statement about AAaaS is FALSE?
options: It is an environment for Data Scientists
It can be offered in a SaaS style
It can be offered in a PaaS style
There is one universally agreed best approach
questions.explanation: Different companies offer different approaches, so there is no one best approach to AAaaS.
